mapper.select: SELECT BANNER_ID, TITLE, IMAGE_DIR, LINK_URL, DISPLAY_ORDER FROM MAIN_SLIDE_IMAGE ORDER BY DISPLAY_ORDER ASC, CDATE DESC

SELECT I.*, B.*, P.PRODUCT_NO, P.PRODUCT_NAME, P.PRICE AS productPrice, P.SALE_YN, P.SALE_PRICE, P.BRAND FROM PRODUCT_IMG I INNER JOIN PRODUCT_BANNER_IMG B ON I.PRODUCT_NO = B.PRODUCT_NO INNER JOIN PRODUCT P ON P.PRODUCT_NO = I.PRODUCT_NO ORDER BY B.PBANNER_IMG_NO

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT R.RALLY_NO, R.RALLY_NAME, R.RALLY_DATE, R.APPLICATION_PERIOD, R.PRICE AS rallyPrice, R.HOST, (SELECT A.IMG_PATH FROM (SELECT IMG_PATH, RALLY_IMG_NO FROM RALLY_IMG WHERE RALLY_NO = R.RALLY_NO ORDER BY RALLY_IMG_NO ASC) A WHERE ROWNUM = 1) AS imgPath FROM RALLY R WHERE TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN R.APPLICATION_PERIOD AND R.RALLY_DATE ORDER BY R.RALLY_DATE ASC, R.CDATE DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{limit}
SELECT IMG_PATH FROM PRODUCT_IMG WHERE PRODUCT_NO = #{productNo} AND ROWNUM = 1 ORDER BY PRODUCT_IMG_NO ASC
SELECT IMG_PATH FROM RALLY_IMG WHERE RALLY_NO = #{rallyNo} AND ROWNUM = 1 ORDER BY RALLY_IMG_NO ASC

SELECT P.PRODUCT_NO, P.PRODUCT_NAME, P.PRICE AS productPrice, P.BRAND, P.SALE_YN, P.SALE_PRICE, (SELECT IMG_PATH FROM (SELECT IMG_PATH, PRODUCT_IMG_NO FROM PRODUCT_IMG WHERE PRODUCT_NO = P.PRODUCT_NO ORDER BY PRODUCT_IMG_NO ASC) WHERE ROWNUM = 1) AS imgPath FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT P.PRODUCT_NO, P.PRODUCT_NAME, P.PRICE, P.BRAND, P.SALE_YN, P.SALE_PRICE, P.QUANTITY, P.TYPE_NO, PT.TYPE_NAME, PT.TYPE_PART, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY P.PRODUCT_NAME ORDER BY P.PRODUCT_NO ASC ) AS rn FROM PRODUCT P INNER JOIN PRODUCT_TYPE PT ON P.TYPE_NO = PT.TYPE_NO WHERE P.QUANTITY > 0 AND ( PT.TYPE_NAME = #{categoryName} OR PT.TYPE_NAME LIKE '%' || #{categoryName} || '%' OR PT.TYPE_PART LIKE '%' || #{categoryName} || '%' OR ( #{categoryName} = '러닝화' AND ( PT.TYPE_NAME LIKE '%신발%' OR PT.TYPE_NAME LIKE '%화%' OR PT.TYPE_NAME LIKE '%운동화%' OR PT.TYPE_PART LIKE '%신발%' OR PT.TYPE_PART LIKE '%화%' ) ) OR ( #{categoryName} = '보호대' AND ( PT.TYPE_NAME LIKE '%보호%' OR PT.TYPE_NAME LIKE '%대%' OR PT.TYPE_PART LIKE '%보호%' ) ) OR ( #{categoryName} = '러닝복 상의' AND ( PT.TYPE_NAME LIKE '%상의%' OR PT.TYPE_NAME LIKE '%상%' OR PT.TYPE_NAME LIKE '%티%' OR PT.TYPE_NAME LIKE '%셔츠%' OR PT.TYPE_PART LIKE '%상의%' OR PT.TYPE_PART LIKE '%상%' ) ) OR ( #{categoryName} = '러닝복 하의' AND ( PT.TYPE_NAME LIKE '%하의%' OR PT.TYPE_NAME LIKE '%하%' OR PT.TYPE_NAME LIKE '%바지%' OR PT.TYPE_NAME LIKE '%팬츠%' OR PT.TYPE_PART LIKE '%하의%' OR PT.TYPE_PART LIKE '%하%' ) ) ) ) P WHERE P.rn = 1 AND ( (P.SALE_YN = 'Y' AND P.SALE_PRICE IS NOT NULL AND P.SALE_PRICE <= #{budget}) OR (P.SALE_YN = 'N' AND P.PRICE <= #{budget}) ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN P.SALE_YN = 'Y' AND P.SALE_PRICE IS NOT NULL THEN P.SALE_PRICE ELSE P.PRICE END DESC
